description: Verifies the analytic dark matter halo profiles: the NFW density and enclosed mass at the scale radius, the location of the peak circular velocity, the sign and direction of the acceleration, the Einasto and Burkert densities at the scale radius, and the Hernquist enclosed mass and potential.

checks.label: the density at the scale radius equals a quarter of the characteristic density
the enclosed mass at the scale radius equals 4 pi rho0 rs^3 (ln 2 - 1/2)
the circular velocity at the reported radius is a local maximum
the acceleration points toward the halo centre
the acceleration has no transverse component on the x axis
the density at the scale radius equals the characteristic density
the density at the scale radius equals a quarter of the characteristic density
a quarter of the mass is enclosed within the scale radius
the potential at the scale radius equals -G M / (2 a)
